content: Plan refined: Will implement bcf_unpack_rs as an unsafe function that parses BCF binary data using safe Rust helpers but writes into the C bcf_dec_t struct using unsafe + libc::realloc for C-compatible memory management. Pure Rust helpers: bcf_type_shift (lookup table), bcf_dec_size_rs, bcf_dec_int1_rs. The main function handles 4 phases: STR (ID+alleles), FLT (filters), INFO, FMT. Differential tests will create records with various field combinations, clone them, unpack one with C and one with Rust, compare decoded fields (id, alleles, n_flt, flt, info keys/types, fmt ids).
